sentences.river: She sat on the grassy bank of the river.
sentences.money: She deposited her paycheck at the bank downtown.

note: REAL DistilBERT (6 blocks). The SAME word 'bank' in a river sentence vs a money sentence: at the embedding layer the two 'bank' tokens are the same static vector (cos=1.0000); each block mixes in context and the two contextual vectors DRIFT APART, so the cross-sense cosine falls from 1.0 toward ~0.65 (matches l6-contextual.json's final-layer cross-sense). proj2d = deterministic PCA(2) of all 14 bank vectors for animating the split. Reproducible: eval(), no_grad(), manual_seed(0).
